units.source_text: 文平贞之妻被太政大臣藤原时平所占，

en.t: Bun no Hirasada's wife was taken by the Chancellor Fujiwara no Tokihira,

units.source_text: 平贞赋诗云：“与君谁绾同心结？

en.t: and Hirasada composed a poem: "With you, who has tied the knot of joined hearts?
Lost in the haze of dreams, I do not know."
This appears in the Later Collection of Japanese Poems.

units.source_text: 后文玉鬘引用此诗第二句，意思是说她嫁与髭黑非出自愿。

en.t: Later, Tamakazura quotes the second line of this poem, meaning that her marriage to Higekuro was not of her own choosing.
